name: Lexus Nine
description: Lexus Nine was a planet in the galaxy that underwent an orbital bombardment sometime prior to the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. The bombardment created a rift under the planet's surface that caused massive cataclysms and wiped out the entire population.
